name: Somchai Srisawat
bio:
Somchai’s journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While working as a general mechanic in his small village outside of Chiang Mai, he was approached by a local racing team struggling with persistent engine failures. His knack for diagnosing and creatively repairing these issues quickly earned him a reputation. He dedicated himself to learning everything he could about precision machining, eventually landing a role with Kosmic Kart. 

Somchai brings a blend of traditional Thai ingenuity and modern technical skill to his work. He's known for his meticulous approach and his ability to adapt and repair equipment under pressure. He believes in understanding the root cause of every mechanical problem, not just applying a quick fix. He's driven by a passion for improving performance and reliability, and is always eager to share his knowledge with younger team members.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline
physical.description: A wiry man of average height, Somchai always has a focused look in his eyes.

quirks: Always chews betel nut while working, claiming it helps him focus.
Has a small Buddha amulet hanging from his workbench.
Whistles traditional Thai folk songs while calibrating machinery.
